title: Midnighter #17 Wildstorm May 2008 American Flag Cover Keith Giffen Chris Garbett
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Midnighter #17 (May 2008), Wildstorm / DC Comics. Written by Keith Giffen, art and American flag cover by Chris Garbett, inks by Rick Burchett. Direct sales edition, $2.99 cover price.

Note: the cover art shows Midnighter hanging upside down - that is how it is printed.

Back cover: Lost Odyssey (Xbox 360) ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
